text.en: The sitios of Lumbangan, Cantarilya and Makukak in the Municipality of Rosario, Province of Batangas, are constituted into a district and independent barrio of said municipality to be known as the barrio of Lumbangan.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
